_comment: Port name -> CPE 2.3 template. '{version}' is substituted with the upstream port version.
PURLs of type 'pkg:vcpkg' are not yet a registered PURL type, so Dependency-Track's
OSS Index / OSV / Snyk analyzers cannot resolve them. The CPE below is what makes
Dependency-Track's *internal* analyzer match the component against its NVD mirror.
Verify every entry against https://nvd.nist.gov/products/cpe/search before adding it -
a wrong vendor slug produces silent false negatives.
Ports with no NVD CPE dictionary entry (fmt, cppcodec, catch2) are intentionally absent.
